stem: Does a technically sound mode-of-action rotation plan authorize a pesticide for cannabis use?
choices: Yes, if the MoA groups alternate.
Yes, if the pest is severe.
Yes, if the active ingredient is used on another crop.
No; current label, crop/site registration, jurisdiction, worker-safety and facility authority still control use.
rationale: Resistance planning does not override pesticide label or legal/operational authorization.
